description_en: Queries the accelerated IP addresses in the acceleration region of a basic Global Accelerator (GA) instance
description_zh: 调用ListBasicAccelerateIps接口查询基础型全球加速实例加速地域下的加速IP信息
kebab_example: aliyun ga list-basic-accelerate-ips --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --ip-set-id ips-bp11r5jb8ogp122xl0000 --accelerate-ip-address 116.132.XX.XX --accelerate-ip-id gaip-bp10000 --next-token FFmyTO70tTpLG6I3FmYAXGKPd0000 --max-results 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListBasicAccelerateIps

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the GA instance is deployed. Set the value to **cn-hangzhou**
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速所在的地域ID，仅取值**cn-hangzhou**
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

>  If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the **request ID** as the **client token**. The **request ID** may be different for each request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

> 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的**RequestId**作为**ClientToken**标识。每次API请求的**RequestId**不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the acceleration region.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2253380.html operation to query the ID of the acceleration region
parameters.help_zh:
基础型全球加速实例的加速地域实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2253380.html查询加速地域实例ID
parameters.name: ip_set_id

parameters.help_en: The accelerated IP address of the basic GA instance
parameters.help_zh: 基础型全球加速实例的加速IP
parameters.name: accelerate_ip_address

parameters.help_en: The ID of the accelerated IP address of the basic GA instance
parameters.help_zh: 基础型全球加速实例的加速IP实例ID
parameters.name: accelerate_ip_id

parameters.help_en:
The token that determines the start point of the query. Valid values:

*   If this is your first query and no next queries are to be sent, ignore this parameter.
*   If a subsequent query is to be sent, set the parameter to the value of NextToken that is returned from the last call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
- 第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
- 如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: **1** to **50**. Default value: **10**
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：**1**~**50**。默认值：**10**
parameters.name: max_results
